page.overview:
What is Route 201?

Sinnoh Route 201 is a route in the Sinnoh region.

Route 201 is a route in southwestern Sinnoh, connecting Twinleaf Town and Sandgem Town. The route also provides access to Lake Verity. It is the first route in Sinnoh and connects to Verity Lakefront.
